rows.qualification: Post Graduate/P.G. Diploma in Human Resource Management from a recognized University/Institution
rows.experience: At least 10 years of administrative experience in a Supervisory capacity in Level 10 and above. Sound knowledge of Govt. of India/Autonomous bodies rules and regulations.

rows.post: Consultant in the FTK-Centre for Information Technology
rows.qualification: Master degree in Computer Science/Applications or Master degree in allied disciplines viz. Mathematics or Physics with Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications from a recognized university
rows.experience: Minimum of 15-years of hands-on experience in managing CMS based large University Portal(s); E-Mail & Group accounts administration; Managing Google Workspace admin account; Proficiency in web technologies including CSS, JavaScript etc.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement conditions, age rules, working hours, and remuneration guidelines are detailed below: Age Limit: A person should not be more than 62 years and in good health at the time of applying for the above mentioned position. Tenure of Engagement: Consultants shall be engaged initially for a period of three months or till attaining the age of 65 years, whichever is earlier. The engagement may be extendable based on performance and requirement, which shall be considered on case to case basis. Remuneration and Allowances: The remuneration, leave, allowances, etc. shall be in accordance with the Department of Expenditure's O.M. No. 3-25-2020.E-IIIA dated 09.12.2020. Working Hours: Working hours shall normally be from 09:00 AM to 05:30 PM during working days. However, in exigencies of work, he/she may be required to sit late and may also be called on Saturdays, Sundays, or other holidays. Nature of Appointment: Consultant shall be appointed on full-time basis and would not be permitted to work anywhere during the period of their engagement in JMI. Tax Deduction at Source (TDS): TDS as admissible shall be deducted from the monthly remuneration of Consultant. A TDS certificate shall be issued by the concerned DDO on demand. Selection Committee: Selection of the Consultant shall be made by a duly constituted Local Selection Committee. The date of interview shall be notified subsequently.

Submit the application form through either of the two approved submission methods: By Email: Send the scanned, complete application and required enclosures to [email protected] . In Person: Submit the hard copy at the Recruitment & Promotion Section, Office of the Registrar, Jamia Millia Islamia, Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Marg, New Delhi – 110025 latest by 26.10.2026 during all working days between 10:00 AM to 05:00 PM (up to 12:00 Noon on Fridays; Lunch Break from 01:00 PM to 02:00 PM). Ensure the complete submission is delivered on or before the deadline of 26 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants must submit complete applications along with the following documents: Duly filled prescribed application form downloaded from the official website Supporting educational qualification certificates and mark sheets Documentary proof of required administrative or technical experience Copy of Pension Payment Order (PPO) Copy of Last Pay Certificate (LPC)

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Engagement of Consultant may be terminated at any time by one month's notice given by either side without assigning any reason. However, in case of resignation, the Consultant will be required to serve a prior notice of one month or one month remuneration in lieu of notice period. The University reserves the right to evolve a uniform and reasonable criterion to shortlist the eligible candidates for interview, if needed. Incomplete applications or applications received after the due date will be rejected. Canvassing, in any form or on behalf of the candidate will be a disqualification. No TA / DA will be paid for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in JMI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for JMI Consultant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications in person or via email is 26 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for JMI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A person should not be more than 62 years and in good health at the time of applying for the position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification for the Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Candidates require a Post Graduate/P.G. Diploma in HRM for the Engineering Faculty post, or a Master's degree in Computer Science/Applications (or allied disciplines with PGDCA) for the FTK-CIT post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary or remuneration for Consultants in JMI?
faq.answer: Remuneration, leave, and allowances are governed in accordance with Department of Expenditure O.M. No. 3-25-2020.E-IIIA dated 09.12.2020.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for JMI Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates submit the application form?
faq.answer: Applications can be emailed to [email protected] or submitted in person at the Recruitment & Promotion Section, Office of the Registrar, Jamia Millia Islamia, New Delhi – 110025.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Eligible shortlisted candidates will be evaluated and selected by a duly constituted Local Selection Committee through an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this appointment permanent or on a contract basis?
faq.answer: The appointment is purely on a contractual basis initially for a period of three months or till attaining 65 years of age, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Who is eligible to apply for these Consultant positions?
faq.answer: Eligible applicants must be retired personnel from any Central Government, State Government, or Autonomous bodies who satisfy the post-wise qualifications and experience.
